subject: Rejection of Council Budget Amendment Power
overview: The committee voted to reject a proposal that would have granted the City Council power to move funds between budget appropriations and established a subcommittee to finalize financial procedure language. Members also reviewed draft articles for the executive and legislative branches, debating term limits, residency requirements, and candidate eligibility.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the previous meeting.

items.title: Article 6 Financial Procedures
items.summary: Anthony Ivan Wilson and Frank Wright of the Collins Center provided an overview of state budget laws, noting that Medford would require a special act of the legislature to grant the City Council power to move funds between line items.

items.title: Council Budget Amendment Power
items.summary: The committee voted to reject a City Council proposal that would have allowed the council to shift funds between different budget appropriations.

items.title: Article 6 Subcommittee Formation
items.summary: A subcommittee was formed to draft the financial procedures article, with a focus on establishing a transparent budget timeline and formalizing public collaboration.

items.title: Draft Articles 2 and 3 Review
items.summary: Members reviewed draft language for the legislative and executive branches, including prohibitions on the mayor holding other paid city positions and the mayor's role as chair of the School Committee.

items.title: Candidate Eligibility and Term Limits
items.summary: The committee discussed public feedback regarding term limits and explored potential residency requirements for ward candidates and felony conviction disqualifications.

items.title: Subcommittee Updates and Scheduling
items.summary: Subcommittees for the School Committee and Article 8 provided updates on their research into recall procedures and future meeting schedules.
